questions.prompt: Which of these are Pixar films?
questions.fact: Pixar started out selling computers. The films were made to show off what the hardware could draw.
Tzatziki, kefir and creme fraiche are all made from milk, and not one of them is a cheese. Cheese needs the curd separated from the whey.

questions.prompt: How long is an Olympic swimming pool, in metres?
questions.fact: Fifty metres, and ten lanes wide, though only eight are ever raced in. The outer two keep the waves down.

questions.prompt: How fast does a passenger jet cruise, in km/h?
questions.fact: About 900 km/h, which is roughly three quarters of the speed of sound at that height.

questions.prompt: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.hint: His crewmate followed him down the ladder twenty minutes later.
questions.fact: Armstrong stepped off the ladder on 20 July 1969. Collins never landed, and orbited alone overhead.

questions.prompt: Who painted The Persistence of Memory, with the melting clocks?
questions.hint: The painter of this one is as famous for his moustache as for his work.
questions.fact: Salvador Dali painted it in 1931. He said the soft watches came to him while looking at a ripe camembert.
